questions.passageText:
**Directions for Questions 1 to 2:** Read the following experimental thermodynamic data before answering questions 1 and 2.

An industrial reactor synthesizes sulfuric acid precursor according to the exothermic gaseous equilibrium: $$\ce{2SO2 + O2 <=> 2SO3}$$ with standard enthalpy change $$\Delta H^\circ = -198\text{ kJ}$$. A secondary sensor cell measures an electrode potential $$E^\circ = \pu{1.10 V}$$.
questions.content: For the exothermic reversible reaction $$\ce{2SO2(g) + O2(g) <=> 2SO3(g)}$$ with $$\Delta H^\circ = -198\text{ kJ}$$, what is the thermodynamic effect of increasing temperature at constant volume?
questions.hindiContent: ऊष्माक्षेपी उत्क्रमणीय अभिक्रिया $$\ce{2SO2(g) + O2(g) <=> 2SO3(g)}$$ के लिए, जहाँ $$\Delta H^\circ = -198\text{ kJ}$$ है, स्थिर आयतन पर तापमान में वृद्धि करने का ऊष्मागतिक प्रभाव क्या होगा?

options.text: Equilibrium shifts towards reactants, reducing yield of $$\ce{SO3}$$
Equilibrium shifts towards products, increasing yield of $$\ce{SO3}$$
Enthalpy of reaction drops to zero

hindiOptions.text: साम्यावस्था अभिकारकों की ओर विस्थापित होती है, जिससे $$\ce{SO3}$$ का उत्पादन घटता है
साम्यावस्था उत्पादों की ओर विस्थापित होती है, जिससे $$\ce{SO3}$$ का उत्पादन बढ़ता है
अभिक्रिया की एन्थैल्पी घटकर शून्य हो जाती है

questions.explanation: According to Le Chatelier's principle, for an exothermic reaction ($$\Delta H^\circ < 0$$), increasing the temperature shifts the equilibrium in the endothermic reverse direction, favouring the reactants.

questions.passageText:
**Directions for Questions 1 to 2:** Read the following experimental thermodynamic data before answering questions 1 and 2.

An industrial reactor synthesizes sulfuric acid precursor according to the exothermic gaseous equilibrium: $$\ce{2SO2 + O2 <=> 2SO3}$$ with standard enthalpy change $$\Delta H^\circ = -198\text{ kJ}$$. A secondary sensor cell measures an electrode potential $$E^\circ = \pu{1.10 V}$$.
questions.content: Using the relation $$\Delta G^\circ = -n F E^\circ$$, calculate the standard Gibbs free energy change for the monitoring cell with $$n = 2$$ electrons, potential $$E^\circ = \pu{1.10 V}$$, and Faraday constant $$F = \pu{96500 C mol-1}$$.
questions.hindiContent: संबंध $$\Delta G^\circ = -n F E^\circ$$ का उपयोग करते हुए, निगरानी सेल के लिए मानक गिब्स मुक्त ऊर्जा परिवर्तन की गणना करें जिसमें $$n = 2$$ इलेक्ट्रॉन, विभव $$E^\circ = \pu{1.10 V}$$, तथा फैराडे नियतांक $$F = \pu{96500 C mol-1}$$ है।
questions.explanation: $$\Delta G^\circ = -nFE^\circ = -2 \times \pu{96500 C mol-1} \times \pu{1.10 V} = -212300\text{ J mol}^{-1} = -212.3\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$$.
